services.0.title: Portfolio / CV wa muntu
services.0.description: Webusite wa portfolio anyi CV wa muntu bua kuleja mushindu wa buenzeji bua tshiena-muntu tshiebe, mudimu webe ne bienzedi bebe bimpe.

services.3.description: Enza bua mudimu udi ubikila misangu mivule bu mamanyisha, dikungija dia bishiminu ne mishindu ya mudimu bienza anu bimeme, bua kampanyi webe ipoke tshikondo.
process.description: Tshitupa tshionso tshidi ne bipatshila bimua kumona, kuela mpala ne kuteleja. Udi umanya bimpe mudimu udi uya kudi.

services.0.long: Webusite wa portfolio anyi CV wa muntu mmbelu webe wa bushuwa pa internet. Tshiena-muntu tshiebe, mudimu webe ne bienzedi bebe bikungijibua pa dibaka dimue didi dipepele kupesha bakubwidi mudimu, basumbi anyi mikuabu ya dilongesha.

services.2.long: Mushindu wa mamanyisha udi ulongolola mudimu udi mu bipungu mu bipeji, mikanda ne mêyi. Makanda adi pa muaba umue, adi apetabua kuudi bienzedi bia muntu ne mikanda yonso idi mua kumonakala pa tshikondo tshionso.
services.2.detail.0: Mushindu wa mudimu muakane udi ulonda mushindu webe wa kuenza
services.2.detail.1: Bienzedi bia bantu ne bukokeshi bua kupita

services.2.detail.4: Muaba wa admin bua kulama bidi mu webusite webe nebe
services.2.for: Bilongelu, bisumbu bikulu, mabuta, mikuna ne makampuni adi musue kulama makanda a mushindu muimpe.
services.3.long: Mudimu udi ubikila misangu mivule bu kutuma mamanyisha, kutuadija makanda pankatshi pa app ne kuenza mikanda ya matuku onso udi mua kuenzeka bimeme. Kampanyi webe ipoka tshikondo ne ibenga mapambuka a kulemba.

services.3.detail.1: Mamanyisha a otomatike pa WhatsApp anyi email
services.3.detail.2: Mishindu ya otomatike ya dikuata mpala ne mikanda
services.3.detail.3: Dilemba dia makanda ku diboko didi dipua bikole
services.3.for: Mudimu ne bisumbu bidi ne mudimu wa ku diboko mubue wa misangu mivule.
process.0.long: Kumpala kua kuenza tshintu, tudi tusue kumvua mudimu webe: tshipatshila tshidi tshinyi, bantu badi bayi kutangila badi kayi ne bienzedi bidi bikengela pa kumpala. Kuibidi tulongolola mudimu bua kuikala ne tshipatshila ne bua kubenga mpetu ya patupu.
process.0.do.0: Kuteleja bipatshila ne mikalu ya mudimu webe
process.0.do.1: Kusungula bimfuanyi bidi musue bu bilondeshi
process.0.do.2: Kusungula bienzedi bikulu ne mushindu wa mudimu
process.0.do.3: Kulongolola tshikondo ne mushinga bua kuenza
process.0.you: Tuambile bidi bikukengela ne tuleje bilondeshi bia mawebusite adi musue.
process.0.result: Mutshi wa bidi bikengela ne bia kumpala bitabujibua pamue.
process.1.long: Tulongolola mushindu wa mabaka ne tshimfuanyi tshia webusite kumpala. Udi mua kukitangila ne kupesha maudi webe kumpala kua kubanga kuenza, bua tshipatshila tshikala pabuipi ne bidi webe wamona mu mêji.
process.1.do.0: Kulongolola mushindu ne njila wa mabaka
process.1.do.1: Kuenza tshimfuanyi: mashimba, dibaka ne mushindu
process.1.do.3: Kushintulula tshimfuanyi bu mudi maudi webe
process.1.you: Tangila tshimfuanyi, kupesha maudi anyi dikuata mpala.
process.1.result: Tshimfuanyi tshitabujibua pamue kumpala kua kubanga dienza.
process.2.long: Pashidi tshimfuanyi tshitabujibua, webusite, app anyi otomatike wenzeka. Udi mushindame pa telefone ne pa ordinatele, ne udi mua kupesha maudi webe padi mudimu ukalakaja.
process.2.do.0: Kuenza mabaka ne bienzedi bu mudi tshimfuanyi
process.2.do.1: Kuenza bua umueneke bimpe pa telefone, pa tablete ne pa ordinatele
process.2.do.2: Kulongolola bia bulelela bua kupeta pa Google
process.2.do.3: Kupesha mapeshi a mudimu misangu yonso
process.2.you: Longolola mêyi, foto ne logo, ne upeshe maudi webe padi nawu.
process.2.result: Tshitupa tshia kumpala tshidi mua kuekesha. Webusite mupepele udi anu umana mu matuku 1–3 a mudimu padi bintu bilongolola.
process.3.long: Tuekesha tshipatshila pamue. Tshidi kaditshi bimpe tshishintulula, kuibidi tuekesha bionso kabidi too pabidi bienza bimpe pa bikuma bishilangane ne bimane kulongolola bua kupatula.
process.3.do.0: Kutangila mushindu pa bunene bua tshikuma bushilangane
process.3.do.3: Kuenza bua bionso bilongolola bua kupatula
process.3.you: Ekesha tshipatshila ne utuambile bidi musue bishintululabue.
process.3.result: Mudimu wa kuekeshabua udi webe mutabuje.
process.4.long: Mudimu upatudibua ne wijula kudi bantu bonso. Tuulongolola bua kupetabua pa Google, kuibidi tukupesha njila wa kupita pamue ne mukanda wa kuwusadila bua uwulame bimpe.
process.4.do.1: Kulongolola metadata ne SEO wa bulelela
process.4.do.2: Kupesha njila wa kupita ne mukanda wa kusadila
process.4.do.3: Kukuambuluisha ne mvula 1 ya mbulamatadi wa buabu, ne domeni (Pakete Munini) anyi hosting (Pakete Munene)
process.4.you: Lama njila webe wa kupita bimpe ne ubange kuwupesha basumbi bebe.
process.4.result: Webusite anyi app udi pa internet ne mmulongolola bua kusadila.

faq.title: Mipusho idi bantu bapusha kumpala kua kubanga.
faq.description: Bu mupusho webe kauyi mujikidibue apa, dituambila didi mua kukuambuluisha kumona bidi bikukengela.
faq.0.question: Nocoding udi mua kuenza mudimu kayi?
faq.0.answer: Tuenza mawebusite a portfolio anyi CV wa muntu, landing page anyi webusite wa kampuni, mishindu ya mamanyisha ne ya mudimu ne otomatike wa mishindu ya mudimu.
faq.1.question: Dienza didi dikata tshikondo tshingapi?
faq.1.answer: Portfolio, CV anyi landing page mupepele udi anu ukata matuku 1-3 a mudimu pashidi bintu bilongolola. Projè minene idi ilonda bienzedi, dikungija ne mushindu wa dipeshibua dia maudi.
faq.2.question: Tshimfuanyi ne bienzedi bidi mua kushintululabua anyi?
faq.2.answer: Eyowa. Tshimfuanyi, mushindu wa mabaka, bienzedi ne mushindu wa mudimu bidi mua kulongoluelabua bu mudi bidi bikukengela. Tshimfuanyi tshidi tshikonkononabua pamue kumpala kua kubanga dienza.
faq.3.question: Mushinga udi ukuata tshinyi?
faq.3.answer: Mushinga udi ukuata dienza bu mudi pakete ne tshitupa tshitabujibua. Pakete Munini udi ne mbulamatadi wa buabu ne domeni mvula 1, ne Pakete Munene udi ne mbulamatadi wa buabu ne hosting mvula 1.
contact.title: Tuambile bidi webusite webe ukeba. Tukukuambuluisha kulongolola njila.
contact.description: Tuma mukenji mupi pa mudimu webe, mabaka adi ukeba ne tshikondo tshidi usue. Dikumbula dia kumpala didi ne bilongesha bia tshitupa ne bia kuya kumpala. Dituambila didi dia buabu misangu yonso, padi ukeba.
footer.tagline: Mawebusite a mudimu alongolola bua kupatula, adi amueneka bimpe ne mepepele kukolesha.
project.category.ecoswap: Webusite wa kusumbisha bintu bia kale
project.description.ecoswap: Mashinyi a pa internet a kusumba ne kusumbisha bintu bia kale. Bantu badi mua kulemba, kukeba ne kusumba bupepele pa telefone anyi ordinatele.
project.description.wiboost: Dibaka dia kusumbisha mudimu wa digitale bu mudi kuekesha mikalu ya jeu, mapakete a makanda ne app ya premium, ne makuta a basumbi ne mushindu wa basumbisha.
project.description.ahawi: Webusite wa portfolio wa muntu wa mushindu wa tshimfuanyi tshia mashimba a mêji, wa luimi luibidi, bua kuleja tshiena-muntu, mudimu ne mamanyisha a dituambila.
project.description.abdi: Mushindu wa makanda a bantu badi basadila mu nzubu wa mukalenge (abdi dalem) wa Keraton ya Surakarta: dilembeshabua, makanda a muntu, mushindu wa mudimu, dilonda ne dipatula dia makarta a dimanyisha.
project.description.sfarm: App wa kulama dibuta dia mikuku ya mayi ne mbuji dia tshisa tshia mbanza: makanda a matuku onso, dikusumbisha, mpetu ya kufuta ne mikanda ya makuta.
project.description.payu: Dibaka didi dikungija bantu badi bapesha mudimu ne bakuenzela mudimu. Mupeshi udi upesha tshilambu, mukuenzela udi umbusha mudimu, ne dikuata mpetu didi dienzeka ku QRIS.
project.description.darcasual: Katalogi wa pa internet udi ne bintu bipita tshinunu. Basumbi badi mua kukeba, kusungula ne kutuma dikumbula dia kusumba bukidi pa WhatsApp.
project.category.ianprem: Dibaka dia pa internet dia app ya premium
project.description.ianprem: Dibaka dia pa internet dia makanda a app ya premium bu mudi Netflix ne Spotify. Basumbi badi basungula ne bafuta bobeneyi, ne bakokeshi badi balama bintu ne dikusumbisha.
project.description.alengka: Katalogi wa pa internet wa bipanda bia munda ne bia kunyima bua bidia, mabaka a kudia ne mbelu. Bantu badi mua kutangila bintu ne kuipuka pa WhatsApp.
project.description.sdn: Webusite wa bushuwa wa kalasa ya ntuadijilu udi ne tshiena-muntu tshia kalasa, mamanyisha a dilembeshibua dia bana bapiabapia, mutshi wa bamfumu, mudimu wa mu kalasa ne bipatshila bia bana.
project.description.furnix: Katalogi wa pa internet wa bipanda bia tshiwa tshia Jepara bua bidia, mabaka a kudia ne mbelu. Bantu badi basungula bintu ne bakumbula bu mudi bidi basue.
project.category.clothique: Dibaka dia pa internet dia bivuadi
project.description.clothique: Dibaka dia pa internet dia bivuadi dilulame: katalogi, mukoba wa kusumba, dikuata mpetu pa internet, blog ne muaba wa admin bua kulama dikumbula ne mikanda.
project.category.agli: App wa kuambuluisha mudimu wa mêyi
project.description.agli: Tshiamu tshia bantu badi benza mêyi bua kukungija bilejilu bia mêyi adi atangibua bungi, kumona mushindu ne kulemba mikanda mipiamupia.
project.description.nebulist: Muambuluishi wa dikusumbisha wa AI udi wenza mushindu, mikanda ya basumbi bakeba ne mikanda ya dituma bu mudi mamanyisha a tshintu.
project.description.carbonfi: App wa makuta a digitale wa kusumbisha makuta a carbon (bilambu bua kupua mushindu wa mpuilu) ne mishindu ya bilambu bia kulama buloba.
project.category.protectedpay: App wa dikuata mpetu dia digitale
project.description.protectedpay: App wa kutuma makuta a digitale mu bulongolodi: makuta adi apatulabua anu padi apetabua, ne dikuata mpetu dia dibuta ne dikuika.
project.category.pedulichain: App wa dipesha dia pa internet
project.description.pedulichain: Dibaka dia dipesha dia patoke: dipesha dionso ne mushindu wa kusadilabua makuta bilembabua bua ku tshiendelele ne bidi bimueneka kudi muntu yonso.
project.description.astra: Muambuluishi wa AI udi mua kuambila nende bua kulama bintu bia digitale, bu mudi kutuma token anyi kuenza bintu bia digitale bia kukungija, kakuyi dimanya dia kulemba programe.
project.description.auditfi: Tshiamu tshia AI tshia kuekesha bulongolodi bua programe ya makuta a digitale tshidi tshikeba bipungu ne tshilemba mukanda mu bipindi bipi.
project.category.p2p: App wa kushintuluisha bintu bia digitale
project.description.p2p: Dibaka dia kushintuluisha bintu bia digitale pankatshi pa bansadidi, ne dikuika dia dikuata mpetu ne muaba wa admin bua kulama dibaka.
project.category.payguppy: App wa dikuata mpetu dia digitale
project.description.payguppy: App udi uambuluisha mabaka a kusumbisha a mudimu bua kukuata makuta a digitale ne makode a QR adi nawu kale.
project.description.tiptap: Dibaka dia bakuenzeji ba mêyi bua kupeta bilambu bia bantu badi batangila mu makuta a digitale anyi bintu bia digitale, ne mamanyisha mu matangidi a bukidi.
project.description.senkus: Jeu wa pa internet wa sayansi ne alchimie: bantu badi bakungija mishindu ya miti, bakungija bintu bia digitale ne badikuata mu muaba wa dikuata.
project.description.quickstock: App wa pa ordinatele wa kulama bintu bia dibaka dia bivuadi: kulemba dikusumbisha, bintu bidi bikula kudi basumbisha ne mikanda ya bintu, ne njila wa kupita bu mudi mudimu wa muenzeji yonso.
project.description.caer: Dibaka dia kuatshisha ne kuata bintu bia digitale pankatshi pa mashinyi ne dilongolola dia rupiya wa digitale IDRX, bua kupepeja dilama ne dikuata.
